messages.body_plain:
Hello all,
I'm new to GGIR and trying to understand all the information it produces. I have results from wrist accelerometers using GGIR 2.2-0 and am interested in sleep information. We did not include sleep logs, so are using the SIB within the estimated SPT as "sleep" which is what I believe the sleep in SPT variables are summarizing. I'm trying to understand the difference between the similar information produced from part 4 and part 5.

E.g. Can someone please explain the difference in calculation, in interpretation and which is "better" to use in estimating sleep for the variables below?

Part 4 person-level
SleepDurationInSpt_AD_T5A5_mn
SptDuration_AD_T5A5_mn
sleep_efficiency_AD_T5A5_mn

Part 5 person-level WW
dur_spt_sleep_min_pla
dur_spt_min_pla
sleep_efficiency_pla

The articles that I've read which used data from GGIR aren't explicit in which part the variables they used are from. Other relevant general information on using/comparing output from parts 4 and 5 is welcome.

Thank you for your time,
Nicolle

I work as a statistician at the Clinical Trials Unit from the University of Bern, Switzerland.
